Ming.name: Zhu Qizhen
Ming.title: Zhengtong Emperor
Ming.note: Captured by the Oirats at Tumu in 1449.

Ming.name: Zhu Youjian
Ming.title: Chongzhen Emperor
Ming.note: Hanged himself when Li Zicheng took Beijing in 1644.

Later Jin.name: Nurhaci
Later Jin.title: Khan of Later Jin (Emperor Taizu of Qing)

Later Jin.name: Hong Taiji
Later Jin.title: Khan of Later Jin (Emperor Taizong of Qing)

Qing (Later Jin).name: Fulin
Qing (Later Jin).title: Shunzhi Emperor
Qing (Later Jin).note: A small child; his uncle Dorgon ruled as regent.
Qing (Later Jin).note_zh: 即位时年幼，由叔父多尔衮摄政。

Mongols (Northern Yuan).name: Toghon Temür
Mongols (Northern Yuan).title: Emperor Huizong (Shundi)
Mongols (Northern Yuan).note: Last Yuan emperor in China; fled north in 1368.
Mongols (Northern Yuan).note_zh: 元朝在中原的最后一位皇帝，1368年北逃。

Mongols (Northern Yuan).name: Batu Möngke
Mongols (Northern Yuan).title: Dayan Khan
Mongols (Northern Yuan).note: Reunited the eastern Mongols; his dates are disputed.
Mongols (Northern Yuan).note_zh: 重新统一东部蒙古，生卒及在位年份有争议。

Mongols (Northern Yuan).name: Altan
Mongols (Northern Yuan).title: Altan Khan (Tümed)
Mongols (Northern Yuan).note: Not the Great Khan, but the most powerful Mongol ruler of his time; made peace with the Ming in 1571.
Mongols (Northern Yuan).note_zh: 并非蒙古大汗，却是当时最强大的蒙古首领；1571年与明朝议和（俺答封贡）。

Oirat Confederation.name: Esen
Oirat Confederation.title: Esen Taishi
Oirat Confederation.note: Took the title of khan in 1453 and was killed in 1454.

Joseon.name: Wang Jeon
Joseon.title: King Gongmin of Goryeo
Joseon.note: Goryeo king; Joseon was founded in 1392.
Joseon.note_zh: 高丽国王，朝鲜王朝建立于1392年。

Joseon.name: Wang Yo
Joseon.title: King Gongyang of Goryeo
Joseon.note: Last Goryeo king, deposed by Yi Seong-gye.
Joseon.note_zh: 高丽末代国王，被李成桂废黜。

Japan.name: Ashikaga Yoshimitsu
Japan.title: Shogun
Japan.note: Received the title 'King of Japan' from the Ming and kept power after retiring until 1408.
Japan.note_zh: 受明朝册封为“日本国王”，退位后仍掌权至1408年。

Japan.name: Oda Nobunaga
Japan.title: Warlord who began the unification of Japan

Japan.name: Toyotomi Hideyoshi
Japan.title: Imperial regent (Kampaku, Taikō)
Japan.note: Took control after Nobunaga's death; unified Japan by 1590 and invaded Korea in 1592 and 1597.
Japan.note_zh: 织田信长死后掌权，1590年统一日本，1592年和1597年两次侵略朝鲜。

Japan.name: Tokugawa Ieyasu
Japan.title: Shogun
Japan.note: Won the Battle of Sekigahara in 1600 and founded the Tokugawa shogunate.
Japan.note_zh: 1600年赢得关原之战，开创德川幕府。

jingnan.losses: The Jianwen Emperor vanished when the palace burned
jingnan.losses_zh: 建文帝在宫中大火中下落不明

tumu.note: The Ming figure is traditional and inflated; the Oirat force was far smaller.
tumu.note_zh: 明军兵力为传统说法，有夸大；瓦剌军人数要少得多。
tumu.losses: Emperor captured; Wang Zhen and many officials killed
tumu.losses_zh: 皇帝被俘，王振及大批官员战死

gengxu-raid.note: The chief minister Yan Song told the generals not to fight, so the raiders looted freely and left.
gengxu-raid.note_zh: 首辅严嵩令诸将坚守不战，蒙古骑兵大掠而去。

taizhou-wokou.losses: Nine battles won in about a month

imjin.note: Ming cannon broke the city's defences; Konishi escaped south.
imjin.note_zh: 明军以火炮攻破城防，小西行长率残部南逃。

sides.name: Ming army
sides.troops_text: c. 100,000 in four columns, with Korean allies
sides.troops_text_zh: 约10万，分四路，另有朝鲜援军

sarhu.note: Nurhaci massed his troops and beat the Ming columns one at a time.
sarhu.note_zh: 努尔哈赤集中兵力，各个击破明军各路。
sarhu.losses: About 45,000 Ming soldiers lost in five days
sarhu.losses_zh: 明军五天内损失约4.5万人

ningyuan.note: European-style 'red barbarian' cannon on the walls stopped the assault.
ningyuan.note_zh: 城头的红夷大炮击退了后金的进攻。

shaanxi-revolts.note: Neither force nor amnesty could stop the revolts, which kept spreading for sixteen years.
shaanxi-revolts.note_zh: 剿与抚都未能平息民变，起义持续蔓延了十六年。

luoyang-1641.losses: The Prince of Fu was killed

routes.name: Xu Da's northern expedition
routes.summary: Ming armies took Shandong and Henan, then marched up the Grand Canal to Dadu, which the Yuan emperor abandoned.
routes.summary_zh: 明军先取山东、河南，再沿运河北上直抵大都，元顺帝弃城北逃。

routes.name: Prince of Yan marches on Nanjing
routes.summary: Zhu Di's army slipped past Jinan, crossed the Yangtze at Guazhou and took Nanjing.
routes.summary_zh: 燕军绕过济南，经徐州、泗州南下，从瓜洲渡江攻克南京。

routes.name: Zheng He's voyages
routes.summary: Seven great fleets sailed from Nanjing to Southeast Asia and India, and later on to Hormuz and East Africa (beyond this map).
routes.summary_zh: 郑和七次率船队从南京出发，远航东南亚、印度，最远到达霍尔木兹和东非。

routes.name: Zhengtong Emperor's march to Tumu
routes.name_zh: 明英宗亲征与土木堡之变
routes.summary: The emperor marched to Datong, turned back, and was caught by the Oirats at Tumu.
routes.summary_zh: 明英宗率军到达大同后撤退，在土木堡被瓦剌追上俘获。

routes.name: Ming Great Wall
routes.summary: The Ming rebuilt the wall in brick and stone from Jiayu Pass to Shanhai Pass.
routes.summary_zh: 明朝用砖石重修长城，西起嘉峪关，东至山海关。

routes.name: Ming armies relieve Korea
routes.summary: Li Rusong's army crossed the Yalu, retook Pyongyang and pushed the Japanese back toward Seoul.
routes.summary_zh: 李如松率军渡过鸭绿江，收复平壤，把日军逼退到汉城一带。

routes.name: Matteo Ricci's journey to Beijing
routes.summary: The Jesuit missionary worked his way from Macau to Beijing, bringing European maps and science.
routes.summary_zh: 耶稣会士利玛窦从澳门一路北上来到北京，带来了欧洲的地图和科学。

people.name: Zheng He
people.known_for: Muslim eunuch admiral who led seven great fleets to Southeast Asia, India, Arabia and East Africa (1405-1433).
people.known_for_zh: 回族宦官，1405-1433年七次率庞大船队远航东南亚、印度、阿拉伯和东非。

people.name: Wang Yangming
people.known_for: Thinker who taught that knowing and acting are one and that everyone has innate good knowing.
people.known_for_zh: 心学大师，主张“知行合一”“致良知”。

people.name: Tang Yin
people.known_for: Suzhou painter and poet, one of the Four Masters of the Ming.
people.known_for_zh: 苏州画家、诗人，“明四家”之一。

people.name: Wu Cheng'en
people.known_for: Traditionally named author of Journey to the West.
people.known_for_zh: 通常认为是《西游记》的作者。

people.name: Li Shizhen
people.known_for: Physician who spent nearly 30 years writing the great Compendium of Materia Medica.
people.known_for_zh: 医药学家，用近三十年写成《本草纲目》。

people.name: Li Zhi
people.known_for: Bold critic of Confucian orthodoxy; he died in prison.
people.known_for_zh: 大胆批判正统理学的思想家，死于狱中。

people.name: Tang Xianzu
people.known_for: Playwright of The Peony Pavilion, a love story of dreams and return from death.
people.known_for_zh: 剧作家，代表作《牡丹亭》。
people.line_en: Love springs from who knows where, and grows ever deeper.

people.name: Matteo Ricci
people.known_for: Italian Jesuit who adapted to Chinese culture and brought European maps and science to Ming scholars.
people.known_for_zh: 意大利耶稣会士，尊重中国礼俗，把西方地图和科学介绍给明朝士人。

people.name: Dong Qichang
people.known_for: Painter, calligrapher and critic whose ideas on painting shaped later Chinese art.
people.known_for_zh: 书画家和评论家，他的画论深刻影响了后世绘画。

people.name: Xu Guangqi
people.known_for: Scholar-official who translated Euclid with Ricci and wrote a great book on agriculture.
people.known_for_zh: 与利玛窦合译《几何原本》，并编著《农政全书》。

people.name: Song Yingxing
people.known_for: Wrote an illustrated encyclopedia of crafts and technology in 1637.
people.known_for_zh: 1637年写成图文并茂的工艺技术百科全书。

works.title: The Exploitation of the Works of Nature

people.name: Xu Xiake
people.known_for: Traveller who walked across much of China for 30 years and kept detailed geographic diaries.
people.known_for_zh: 旅行家，三十年间走遍大半个中国，留下详细的地理考察日记。

people.name: Xu Da
people.known_for: Leading general of the Hongwu Emperor who captured Dadu (Beijing) in 1368 and drove the Yuan court north.
people.known_for_zh: 明朝开国第一功臣，1368年攻克元大都，驱逐蒙元。

people.name: Chang Yuchun
people.known_for: Fearless early Ming general who fought alongside Xu Da in the northern campaign against the Yuan.
people.known_for_zh: 明初猛将，与徐达共同北伐灭元，号称“常十万”。

people.name: Liu Ji (Liu Bowen)
people.known_for: Strategist and adviser to Zhu Yuanzhang, helping found the Ming; later legendary as a seer.
people.known_for_zh: 朱元璋的谋士，辅佐开创明朝，后世传为神机妙算的军师。

people.name: Li Shanchang
people.known_for: First chancellor of the Ming, organiser of the new state, executed in the Hu Weiyong purges.
people.known_for_zh: 明朝开国丞相，主持制度建设，后受胡惟庸案牵连被杀。

people.name: Song Lian
people.known_for: Leading early Ming scholar who directed compilation of the History of Yuan.
people.known_for_zh: 明初文臣之首，主持编修《元史》。

people.name: Zhu Yuanzhang (Hongwu Emperor)
people.known_for: Peasant-born rebel who founded the Ming dynasty in 1368 and ruled autocratically from Nanjing.
people.known_for_zh: 出身贫农，1368年建立明朝，定都南京，强化皇权。

people.name: Zhu Di (Yongle Emperor)
people.known_for: Usurped the throne, moved the capital to Beijing, built the Forbidden City and sponsored Zheng He's voyages.
people.known_for_zh: 发动靖难之役夺位，迁都北京，修建紫禁城，派郑和下西洋。

people.name: Fang Xiaoru
people.known_for: Confucian scholar executed with his clan for refusing to draft the Yongle Emperor's accession edict.
people.known_for_zh: 建文帝重臣，拒为朱棣草诏，被诛十族。

people.name: Xie Jin
people.known_for: Grand Secretary who led compilation of the vast Yongle Encyclopedia.
people.known_for_zh: 明代才子，主持编纂《永乐大典》。

people.name: Yu Qian
people.known_for: Minister of War who defended Beijing against the Oirats after the Tumu Crisis of 1449.
people.known_for_zh: 土木堡之变后主持北京保卫战，击退瓦剌。

people.name: Hai Rui
people.known_for: Incorruptible official famous for remonstrating with the Jiajing Emperor; a lasting symbol of honesty.
people.known_for_zh: 以清廉刚直著称，曾上疏痛斥嘉靖帝，人称“海青天”。

people.name: Zhang Juzheng
people.known_for: Senior Grand Secretary under Wanli who restored state finances through the Single Whip tax reform.
people.known_for_zh: 万历首辅，推行考成法与一条鞭法，振兴明朝财政。

people.name: Qi Jiguang
people.known_for: General who crushed the wokou pirates on the southeast coast and later strengthened the Great Wall.
people.known_for_zh: 抗倭名将，组建戚家军平定东南倭患，后镇守蓟州长城。

people.name: Yu Dayou
people.known_for: Anti-pirate general who campaigned with Qi Jiguang along the Fujian and Zhejiang coasts.
people.known_for_zh: 抗倭名将，与戚继光并称“俞龙戚虎”。

people.name: Yan Song
people.known_for: Powerful Grand Secretary under Jiajing, remembered as an archetypal corrupt minister.
people.known_for_zh: 嘉靖朝权臣，专权二十年，被视为奸臣典型。

people.name: Wei Zhongxian
people.known_for: Eunuch who dominated the Tianqi court and persecuted the Donglin faction.
people.known_for_zh: 天启朝专权宦官，号“九千岁”，迫害东林党人。

people.name: Yuan Chonghuan
people.known_for: Defended Ningyuan against Nurhaci with Portuguese cannon; later executed on false charges of treason.
people.known_for_zh: 宁远大捷击退努尔哈赤，后遭诬陷被崇祯帝处死。

people.name: Sun Chengzong
people.known_for: Statesman-general who built the Shanhai Pass–Ningyuan defence line against the Manchus.
people.known_for_zh: 督师辽东，构筑关宁锦防线抵御后金。

people.name: Shi Kefa
people.known_for: Southern Ming commander who died defending Yangzhou against the Qing in 1645.
people.known_for_zh: 南明督师，1645年死守扬州，城破殉国。

people.name: Li Zicheng
people.known_for: Rebel leader whose army took Beijing in 1644, ending the Ming dynasty.
people.known_for_zh: 明末农民军领袖，建立大顺，1644年攻入北京灭明。

people.name: Zhang Xianzhong
people.known_for: Late Ming rebel leader who founded the short-lived Great Western Kingdom in Sichuan.
people.known_for_zh: 明末农民军领袖，在四川建立大西政权。

people.name: Luo Guanzhong
people.known_for: Author credited with the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, one of the Four Great Classical Novels.
people.known_for_zh: 元末明初小说家，著《三国演义》。

people.name: Shi Nai'an
people.known_for: Writer traditionally credited with the novel Water Margin.
people.known_for_zh: 元末明初小说家，相传著《水浒传》。

people.name: Feng Menglong
people.known_for: Compiled the Three Words collections of vernacular short stories.
people.known_for_zh: 通俗文学家，编纂“三言”白话短篇小说集。

people.name: Ling Mengchu
people.known_for: Author of the Two Slaps vernacular story collections.
people.known_for_zh: 小说家，著“二拍”拟话本小说集。

people.name: Gui Youguang
people.known_for: Prose master whose intimate essays shaped later Chinese prose style.
people.known_for_zh: 明代散文大家，以《项脊轩志》等抒情散文著称。

people.name: Wen Zhengming
people.known_for: Leading Wu School painter and calligrapher, one of the Four Masters of the Ming.
people.known_for_zh: 吴门画派代表，明四家之一，诗书画俱佳。

people.name: Shen Zhou
people.known_for: Founder of the Wu School of painting in Suzhou.
people.known_for_zh: 吴门画派开创者，明四家之首。

people.name: Qiu Ying
people.known_for: Master of meticulous figure and landscape painting, one of the Four Masters of the Ming.
people.known_for_zh: 工笔人物山水大家，明四家之一。

works.title: Along the River During the Qingming Festival (Ming version)

people.name: Zhu Yunming
people.known_for: Celebrated Suzhou calligrapher famed for wild cursive script.
people.known_for_zh: 明代书法家，以狂草闻名，吴中四才子之一。

people.name: Xu Wei
people.known_for: Eccentric painter, poet and dramatist, pioneer of expressive freehand ink painting.
people.known_for_zh: 大写意花鸟画开创者，兼擅诗文戏曲。

people.name: Chen Hongshou
people.known_for: Late Ming figure painter known for stylised, archaic figures and woodblock designs.
people.known_for_zh: 明末人物画大家，造型奇古，与崔子忠并称“南陈北崔”。

people.name: Zhu Zaiyu
people.known_for: Ming prince who first calculated twelve-tone equal temperament precisely.
people.known_for_zh: 明宗室学者，首创十二平均律的精确计算。

works.title: Complete Collection of Music and Pitch

people.name: Pan Jixun
people.known_for: Hydraulic engineer who managed the Yellow River with the 'confine the water to attack the silt' method.
people.known_for_zh: 治河专家，提出“束水攻沙”治理黄河。

people.name: Ji Cheng
people.known_for: Garden designer who wrote the first systematic Chinese treatise on garden making.
people.known_for_zh: 造园家，著中国第一部园林专著《园冶》。

people.name: Kuai Xiang
people.known_for: Master builder who helped design the Forbidden City and Tiananmen.
people.known_for_zh: 香山帮匠师，参与设计建造紫禁城与承天门。

people.name: Wu Youxing
people.known_for: Physician who proposed that epidemics are caused by external pestilential agents.
people.known_for_zh: 温病学家，提出“戾气”致疫学说。

people.name: Zhang Jiebin (Zhang Jingyue)
people.known_for: Physician who emphasised warming and tonifying therapies; author of the Complete Works of Jingyue.
people.known_for_zh: 温补派医家，著《景岳全书》。

check.n: Wikipedia gives 1563 – 1642; sources differ, the map keeps the dates it had.
check.n_zh: 维基百科作1563年—1642年；诸说不一，地图暂沿用原年代。

people.name: Luo Hongxian
people.known_for: Cartographer who produced the gridded Enlarged Terrestrial Atlas based on Zhu Siben's map.
people.known_for_zh: 地图学家，在朱思本地图基础上编成《广舆图》。

people.name: Wei Liangfu
people.known_for: Musician who refined Kunshan singing into Kunqu, the classic opera style.
people.known_for_zh: 戏曲音乐家，改革昆山腔，被尊为“昆曲之祖”。

check.n: Chinese Wikipedia gives Wei Liangfu as before 1522 to c. 1586.
check.n_zh: 中文维基百科称魏良辅生于1522年以前，约卒于1586年。

people.name: Gu Xiancheng
people.known_for: Restored the Donglin Academy, centre of the moralist Donglin movement.
people.known_for_zh: 重建东林书院，东林党领袖。

people.name: Wang Gen
people.known_for: Salt-worker disciple of Wang Yangming who founded the populist Taizhou School.
people.known_for_zh: 王阳明弟子，创立泰州学派，倡“百姓日用即道”。

people.name: Chen Xianzhang
people.known_for: Neo-Confucian thinker who stressed quiet sitting and self-realisation, forerunner of Wang Yangming.
people.known_for_zh: 心学先驱，主张静坐自得，人称“白沙先生”。

people.name: Li Mengyang
people.known_for: Leader of the Former Seven Masters who urged a return to Qin-Han prose and High Tang poetry.
people.known_for_zh: 前七子领袖，倡“文必秦汉，诗必盛唐”。

people.name: Wang Shizhen
people.known_for: Leader of the Latter Seven Masters and dominant literary critic of his age.
people.known_for_zh: 后七子领袖，主盟文坛二十年。

people.name: Yuan Hongdao
people.known_for: Leader of the Gong'an School advocating spontaneous expression of one's true nature.
people.known_for_zh: 公安派领袖，主张“独抒性灵，不拘格套”。

people.name: Francis Xavier
people.known_for: Jesuit missionary who died on Shangchuan Island while trying to enter China.
people.known_for_zh: 耶稣会传教士，试图入华传教，病逝于上川岛。

people.name: Giulio Aleni
people.known_for: Jesuit 'Confucius of the West' in Fujian who wrote a world geography in Chinese.
people.known_for_zh: 意大利耶稣会士，在福建传教，著《职方外纪》。

works.title: Areas Outside the Concern of the Imperial Geographer

people.name: Qin Liangyu
people.known_for: Woman general whose White Staff Army fought the Manchus and rebels for the Ming.
people.known_for_zh: 明末女将，率白杆兵抗清、平叛，正史列传的女将军。

people.name: Cheng Dawei
people.known_for: Mathematician whose abacus arithmetic manual became the standard for centuries.
people.known_for_zh: 珠算家，著《算法统宗》，推动珠算普及。

people.name: Wang Meng
people.known_for: Landscape painter with dense textured brushwork, one of the Four Masters of the Yuan.
people.known_for_zh: 元四家之一，赵孟頫外孙，山水繁密。

people.name: Huang Zongxi
people.known_for: Thinker who argued that rulers should serve the people, not the other way round.
people.known_for_zh: 思想家，批判君主专制，主张天下为主、君为客。

people.name: Gu Yanwu
people.known_for: Ming loyalist scholar who urged practical, evidence-based learning.
people.known_for_zh: 明遗民学者，倡导经世致用和实证学风。

people.name: Dorgon
people.known_for: Manchu prince-regent who led the Qing into Beijing in 1644 and consolidated its conquest.
people.known_for_zh: 摄政王，1644年率清军入关定鼎北京。

people.name: Wu Sangui
people.known_for: Ming general who let the Qing through Shanhai Pass, later led the Revolt of the Three Feudatories.
people.known_for_zh: 引清兵入关，后据云南发动三藩之乱。

people.name: Hong Chengchou
people.known_for: Ming commander who defected to the Manchus and directed the Qing conquest of the south.
people.known_for_zh: 明末降清重臣，经略江南西南，助清统一。

people.name: Li Yu
people.known_for: Playwright, novelist and publisher whose Mustard Seed Garden press issued a famous painting manual.
people.known_for_zh: 戏剧家、小说家，著《闲情偶寄》，主持芥子园书坊。

people.name: Zhang Dai
people.known_for: Essayist whose nostalgic sketches recall the lost world of late Ming Jiangnan.
people.known_for_zh: 明清之际散文家，著《陶庵梦忆》《西湖梦寻》。

people.name: Johann Adam Schall von Bell
people.known_for: German Jesuit astronomer who headed the Qing Imperial Bureau of Astronomy.
people.known_for_zh: 德国耶稣会士，执掌清钦天监，修订《时宪历》。

capitals.name: Nanjing (Yingtian)
capitals.note: Capital until the Yongle Emperor moved to Beijing; then the secondary capital.
capitals.note_zh: 永乐迁都前为首都，此后为陪都。

capitals.name: Beijing
capitals.note: Yongle moved the capital here in 1421.

capitals.name: Karakorum
capitals.note: The Mongol court retreated to the steppe after losing Dadu.
capitals.note_zh: 蒙古朝廷失去大都后退回草原。

capitals.name: Đông Kinh
capitals.note: Capital after Lê Lợi drove out the Ming.
capitals.note_zh: 黎利驱逐明军后定都于此。

capitals.name: Shuri
capitals.note: Capital of the unified Ryukyu Kingdom.
capitals.note_zh: 统一后的琉球王国都城。

capitals.name: Hetu Ala
capitals.note: Nurhaci founded the Later Jin here.
capitals.note_zh: 努尔哈赤在此建立后金。

capitals.name: Shenyang (Mukden)
capitals.note: Hong Taiji renamed the state Qing here in 1636.

capitals.name: Lhasa
capitals.note: Government of the Fifth Dalai Lama, set up with Güshi Khan's help.
capitals.note_zh: 在固始汗支持下建立的五世达赖喇嘛政权。
